# abearchitectstudio

Architecture, objects and spatial experiments — an independent design practice working between architecture and the object.

## What this site offers
- Design Anomaly: experimental architecture and spatial research (subtraction, displacement, folding, collision)
- Design Furniture: objects and furniture understood as small architecture
- Project detail pages with concept, design operations, transformation and project information
- About page with practice statement and contact

## Pages
- / — home with selected works
- /anomaly — Design Anomaly collection
- /furniture — Design Furniture collection
- /project/{slug} — project detail
- /about — studio information

Contact: studio@abearchitectstudio.com
